## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check .` passes
- [ ] `mypy app` passes (strict; no new unjustified ignores)
- [ ] `pytest -q` passes
- [ ] Added/updated tests for the change

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or PII committed
